what: Over the panel, an invisible circle keeps tracking the mouse position (while off, it follows slowly with a .125s ease-in), and once it is over a clickable spot, an ivory translucent circle (106px diameter, 2px backdrop blur) turns on in .125s, scaling .5 → 1 and fading 0 → 1, showing the ”Click” text, with a ring of uppercase letters around it turning upright once every 5 seconds. While on, it sticks to the cursor with no lag, and when the cursor leaves it turns off immediately, then follows slowly again after 125ms. Over cards with data-shadow, a shadow is laid down. It is absent below 768px width, on touch, and during html.fx-modal-open

options.text: Text inside the circle, default 「Click」 — can be changed per spot with data-label
options.ring: Text to wrap around the ring (in uppercase), the default is the attached element’s aria-label or “Studio Name Design Team”
options.min: Turns off below this width (px), default 768
options.leave: Time (ms) to return to delayed follow after moving away, default 125
options.--fx-size: Circle diameter (set in css on .fx-rlp), default 6.235em (106px at 17px text)
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Where the circle turns on — data-label (text inside the circle) and data-shadow (shadow)

note: The original ring was a glyph outline SVG (index_ico_stk01.svg) spun via ::before — the part takes text and draws it with textPath. The original shadow above the card was filter: drop-shadow(10px 20px 40px), so it was swapped for the skin shadow (--kf-shadow-lift)

from.where: index.html team photos and names, work cards, shortcut band (original .pointerWrap.fn-Pointer — #wrap mousemove sets left/top from pageX·pageY, :not(.-hover) opacity 0·scale .5, :not(.-move) left·top .125s ease-in, -mask drop-shadow, ::before rotateIf 5s linear)
